### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-post-status.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import type { MiddlewareHandler } from "hono";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import type { AppEnv } from "../../src/env";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial } from "../../src/social";
import { newPostRow, removeFixtures } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

type App = ReturnType<typeof createApp>;

/**
 * The status of a post's page (3f design, sections 5 and 7.12; invariant 19, the API's part; Caddy's part is the stack's
 * smoke test). GET /api/posts/:id/status is the social module's own small router, mounted after the global limit and
 * before the session's resolution: it answers 204 exactly when the post is visible and 404 with no body otherwise (no
 * such post, a malformed id, a post its author deleted, withheld, removed or disabled), the same for every viewer, so it
 * tells nothing a signed-out read of the post does not, and never 451. It reads no session, whatever the request carries.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the status of a post's page", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let app: App;
  let resolved = 0;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const posts: Record<string, string> = {};

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer: new MemoryMailer(),
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    // The session's resolution, counted: the status route must never reach it.
    const resolveSession: MiddlewareHandler<AppEnv> = (c, next) => {
      resolved++;
      return auth.resolveSession(c, next);
    };
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth: { ...auth, resolveSession }, social });

    // One post in each stored state, written as the migrator, who alone sets a level and a state.
    const author = await newProfile(apiDb);
    authors.push(author.id);
    for (const state of ["visible", "deleted_by_author", "withheld", "removed", "disabled"] as const) {
      const id = await newPostRow(apiDb, author.id);
      if (state === "deleted_by_author") await migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${id}::uuid`);
      else if (state !== "visible") await migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = ${state}::post_state, moderation_level = ${state}::moderation_level where id = ${id}::uuid`);
      posts[state] = id;
    }
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const status = (id: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) => app.request(`/api/posts/${id}/status`, { headers });

  test("204 with no body for a visible post, 404 with no body for every other state and for a post that does not exist", async () => {
    const visible = await status(posts.visible!);
    expect(visible.status).toBe(204);
    expect(await visible.text()).toBe("");
    for (const state of ["deleted_by_author", "withheld", "removed", "disabled"]) {
      const res = await status(posts[state]!);
      expect([state, res.status, await res.text()]).toEqual([state, 404, ""]);
    }
    const missing = await status(randomUUID());
    expect([missing.status, await missing.text()]).toEqual([404, ""]);
  });

  test("a malformed id is 404 with no body, never the validator's JSON", async () => {
    for (const id of ["not-a-uuid", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000g", encodeURIComponent("../health"), "x".repeat(300)]) {
      const res = await status(id);
      expect([id, res.status, await res.text()]).toEqual([id, 404, ""]);
    }
  });

  test("it reads no session: a cookie and a bearer token change nothing, and the session's resolution is never reached", async () => {
    resolved = 0;
    const carried = { cookie: "korbat_session=abc; __Host-korbat_session=def", authorization: `Bearer ${"a".repeat(43)}` };
    expect((await status(posts.visible!, carried)).status).toBe(204);
    expect((await status(posts.withheld!, carried)).status).toBe(404);
    expect(resolved).toBe(0);
    // The post's own read, beside it, does go through the session's resolution.
    await app.request(`/api/posts/${posts.visible!}`, { headers: carried });
    expect(resolved).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test("it answers what a signed-out read of the post answers, state by state, and never 451", async () => {
    for (const [state, id] of Object.entries(posts)) {
      const read = await app.request(`/api/posts/${id}`);
      const asked = await status(id);
      expect([state, asked.status === 204, read.status === 200]).toEqual([state, read.status === 200, asked.status === 204]);
      expect(asked.status).not.toBe(451);
    }
  });

  test("it stands behind the global limit, as every other route of the app does", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryStore();
    const limited = createApp({
      config,
      logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
      rateLimitStore: store,
      healthChecks: {},
      auth: { ...createAuth({ config, logger: pino({ level: "silent" }), authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb), turnstile: { verify: async () => true }, breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false } }) },
      social: createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore: store, logger: pino({ level: "silent" }), requireSession: async (_c, next) => next(), requireFreshAuth: async (_c, next) => next() }),
    });
    let last = 0;
    for (let n = 0; n < 301; n++) last = (await limited.request(`/api/posts/${randomUUID()}/status`)).status;
    expect(last).toBe(429);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-preservation.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_DRAFTS, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ORDER_NOTICE, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { authorDecisionView } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { takeSnapshot } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { orderView } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { duePreservations, endPreservation, orderErasedOn } from "../../src/moderation/orders-repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, decideIn, imagePost, moderationDeps, newTestStaff, refusal, removeFixtures, report, rowCounts, staffProfile, suspectItemOn, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, ageOrderForTest, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest, sessionOf } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/** Past the six months and a day of any preservation: 200 days, in minutes, as ageOrderForTest takes them. */
const PAST_THE_END = 200 * 24 * 60;

/**
 * The end of an order's preservation (3f design, sections 6.4, 7.11 and 7.18; invariant 11, Task 4's part: the end).
 * order_preservation_end takes the cases, the item, the post and its image rows, then judges: not_due before
 * preserve_until and once ended; while the post is still frozen it changes nothing and answers false, so the next round
 * tries again; when the item's measure no longer stands it ends the preservation and erases nothing; otherwise it blanks
 * the post, marks its image rows erased, erases every snapshot of the post in every case, releases the case's holds,
 * derives the level (removed, for good) and records preservation_ended by the system. The notice then says that the
 * content was erased, and a reinstatement after it says that nothing can be shown again. The candidates the retention
 * job reads are the items due and not ended. Every test runs in a transaction that is rolled back, as the migrator, who
 * alone moves an order's times back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the end of an order's preservation", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A post with images under a removal order given effect by the moderator. */
  async function given(tx: DbTx, images = 2): Promise<{ view: OrderView; postId: string; authorId: string; mediaIds: string[] }> {
    const p = await imagePost(tx, images);
    const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
    return { view: await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order)), ...p };
  }
  const end = (tx: DbTx, itemId: string) => tx.execute<{ done: boolean }>(sql`select public.order_preservation_end(${itemId}::uuid) as done`).then((rows) => rows[0]!.done);
  const postOf = async (tx: DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ body: string; level: string; state: string; erased: string | null }>(
      sql`select body, moderation_level::text as level, state::text as state, erased_at::text as erased from public.posts where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;
  const itemOf = async (tx: DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ ended: string | null; until: string | null }>(sql`select preserve_ended_at::text as ended, preserve_until::text as until from public.legal_order_items where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  const imagesOf = async (tx: DbTx, postId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ erased: boolean; state: string }>(sql`select erased_at is not null as erased, moderation_state::text as state from public.post_media where post_id = ${postId}::uuid order by id`)).map((row) => [row.erased, row.state]);
  const snapshotsOf = async (tx: DbTx, postId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ case_id: string; erased: boolean; body: string | null }>(
      sql`select case_id::text, erased_at is not null as erased, body from public.evidence_snapshots where target_type = 'post' and target_id = ${postId}::uuid order by taken_at, id`,
    )).map((row) => ({ caseId: row.case_id, erased: row.erased, body: row.body }));
  const eventsOf = async (tx: DbTx, itemId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; via: string; by: string | null }>(sql`select kind, via, by_staff::text as by from public.legal_order_events where item_id = ${itemId}::uuid order by at, id`)).map((row) => [row.kind, row.via, row.by]);
  const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  test("before preserve_until it is not due and changes nothing; a DSA order's item, which preserves nothing, never is", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const { view, postId } = await given(tx);
      const item = view.items[0]!;
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => end(sp, item.id)))).toBe("not_due");
      expect((await postOf(tx, postId)).body).not.toBe("");
      expect(await duePreservations(tx as unknown as Db)).not.toContain(item.id);
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const dsa = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [p.postId], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      const done = await effectWith(tx, admin, dsa.id, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true });
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, dsa.id, PAST_THE_END);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => end(sp, done.items[0]!.id)))).toBe("not_due");
      expect(await duePreservations(tx as unknown as Db)).not.toContain(done.items[0]!.id);
    });
  });

  test("at its end, while the measure stands: the post blanked, erased and removed for good, its images erased, every snapshot of it erased in every case, the case's holds released, preservation_ended by the system; a second call is not due", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // A report first, decided "no violation", leaves a closed case with its own snapshot of the post; the order's
      // effect then opens a case of its own, with the snapshot the effect takes.
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
      await decideIn(tx, moderator, reported.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      const view = await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      const item = view.items[0]!;
      expect(item.caseId).not.toBe(reported.caseId);
      const holdsBefore = await tx.execute<{ case_id: string; released: boolean }>(
        sql`select case_id::text, released_at is not null as released from public.media_holds where media_id = any(${`{${p.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) order by case_id`,
      );
      expect(holdsBefore.some((h) => h.case_id === item.caseId && !h.released)).toBe(true);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, PAST_THE_END);
      expect(await duePreservations(tx as unknown as Db)).toContain(item.id);

      expect(await end(tx, item.id)).toBe(true);
      const post = await postOf(tx, p.postId);
      const ended = await itemOf(tx, item.id);
      expect([post.body, post.level]).toEqual(["", "removed"]);
      // The erasure and the end are the same instant: how every reader tells an erasure from an end without one.
      expect(post.erased).toBe(ended.ended);
      expect(await imagesOf(tx, p.postId)).toEqual([
        [true, "removed"],
        [true, "removed"],
      ]);
      const snapshots = await snapshotsOf(tx, p.postId);
      expect(new Set(snapshots.map((s) => s.caseId))).toEqual(new Set([reported.caseId, item.caseId!]));
      expect(snapshots.every((s) => s.erased && s.body === null)).toBe(true);
      const holds = await tx.execute<{ case_id: string; released: boolean }>(
        sql`select case_id::text, released_at is not null as released from public.media_holds where media_id = any(${`{${p.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and case_id = ${item.caseId}::uuid`,
      );
      expect(holds.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(holds.every((h) => h.released)).toBe(true);
      expect((await eventsOf(tx, item.id)).at(-1)).toEqual(["preservation_ended", "system", null]);
      expect(await duePreservations(tx as unknown as Db)).not.toContain(item.id);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => end(sp, item.id)))).toBe("not_due");

      // The order's screen and the case page read the erasure's day; the notice says the content was erased.
      const read = (await orderView(moderationDeps(tx), order.id, { role: "admin" }))!;
      expect(read.items[0]!.erasedAt).toBe(read.items[0]!.preserveEndedAt);
      expect(read.items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
      expect(await orderErasedOn(tx as unknown as Db, p.postId)).toBe(today());
      const notice = await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), p.authorId, item.decisionId!);
      expect(notice.erasedOn).toBe(today());
      expect(notice.content).toBeNull();
      const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(notice, { texts: notice.orderTexts ?? null, erasedOn: notice.erasedOn ?? null });
      expect(paragraphs).toContain(ORDER_NOTICE.erased(today()));
      expect(paragraphs.some((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("korbat keeps the post"))).toBe(false);

      // A reinstatement after the erasure lifts the measure and restores nothing, and its notice says so. The case's
      // copies were erased with the post, so the admin takes a fresh one of the erased post first, as the console does.
      const fresh = await takeSnapshot(moderationDeps(tx), sessionOf(admin), item.caseId!);
      const correction = await decideIn(tx, admin, item.caseId!, {
        kind: "correction",
        reviewsDecisionId: item.decisionId!,
        outcome: "reversed",
        actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", orderGround: "annulled" }],
        snapshotId: fresh.id,
        snapshotDigest: fresh.digest,
      });
      expect((await postOf(tx, p.postId)).level).toBe("removed");
      expect((await postOf(tx, p.postId)).body).toBe("");
      const reinstated = await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), p.authorId, correction);
      expect(reinstated.erasedOn).toBe(today());
      expect(statementParagraphs(reinstated, { texts: reinstated.orderTexts ?? null, erasedOn: reinstated.erasedOn ?? null })).toEqual([
        statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(tx as unknown as Db, correction))!.statement)[0],
        ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate.annulled,
        ORDER_NOTICE.reinstated.erased(today()),
        ORDER_NOTICE.lifted,
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("while the post is still frozen it changes nothing and answers false, and the item stays a candidate for the next round", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const { view, postId } = await given(tx, 1);
      const item = view.items[0]!;
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, view.id, PAST_THE_END);
      // An unanswered suspect report about the post freezes it, whatever the order's preservation does.
      await suspectItemOn(tx, "post", postId);
      const bodyBefore = (await postOf(tx, postId)).body;
      expect(await end(tx, item.id)).toBe(false);
      expect((await itemOf(tx, item.id)).ended).toBeNull();
      expect((await postOf(tx, postId)).body).toBe(bodyBefore);
      expect((await postOf(tx, postId)).erased).toBeNull();
      expect(await imagesOf(tx, postId)).toEqual([[false, "visible"]]);
      expect((await eventsOf(tx, item.id)).map((event) => event[0])).not.toContain("preservation_ended");
      expect(await duePreservations(tx as unknown as Db)).toContain(item.id);
    });
  });

  test("an item whose measure no longer stands ends its preservation and erases nothing", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const { view, postId } = await given(tx, 1);
      const item = view.items[0]!;
      await decideIn(tx, admin, item.caseId!, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: item.decisionId!, outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", orderGround: "withdrawn" }] });
      // The reinstatement ended the preservation; an imported item (Task 6) can still hold one without a measure.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_ended_at = null where id = ${item.id}::uuid`);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, view.id, PAST_THE_END);
      expect(await end(tx, item.id)).toBe(true);
      const post = await postOf(tx, postId);
      expect([post.level, post.erased]).toEqual(["visible", null]);
      expect(post.body).not.toBe("");
      expect(await imagesOf(tx, postId)).toEqual([[false, "visible"]]);
      expect((await itemOf(tx, item.id)).ended).not.toBeNull();
      expect((await eventsOf(tx, item.id)).at(-1)).toEqual(["preservation_ended", "system", null]);
      expect(await orderErasedOn(tx as unknown as Db, postId)).toBeNull();
      const read = (await orderView(moderationDeps(tx), view.id, { role: "admin" }))!;
      expect(read.items[0]!.erasedAt).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("a re-disabling counts anew: past the first end and before the second, the item is no candidate and nothing is erased", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const { view, postId } = await given(tx, 1);
      const item = view.items[0]!;

  });

  test("the API's role may call the four functions, and nobody else may", async () => {
    const rows = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ name: string; api: boolean; anyone: boolean }>(sql`
      select p.proname as name, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as api, has_function_privilege('korbat_auth', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as anyone
        from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
       where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('order_preservation_end', 'order_records_due', 'erase_order_records', 'delete_contact_messages')
       order by p.proname`);
    expect(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.api, row.anyone])).toEqual([
      ["delete_contact_messages", true, false],
      ["erase_order_records", true, false],
      ["order_preservation_end", true, false],
      ["order_records_due", true, false],
    ]);
  });
```

```ts
import { randomInt } from "node:crypto";

import { ORDER_RULES, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { RETENTION_ACTION, retentionRound } from "../../src/moderation/retention";

import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, outboxOf } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, ageOrderForTest, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

const DAY = 24 * 60;

const PAST_THE_RECORDS = (ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears * 366 + 2) * DAY;

 * How long an order's records and the contact point's messages are kept (3f design, sections 6.4, 6.8 and 7.18;
 * invariant 21, orders and messages). order_records_due() names an order three years after its newest event, and never
 * while a measure of it stands, a preservation of it runs or a decision about one of its posts is untold; erase_order_records
 * deletes its events, items, row and message and keeps the ledger. delete_contact_messages deletes a message 30 days after
 * it was handled and the outbox rows that old, but never an unhandled message, stale or not, nor the rows of a subject
 * still open, so alert_steps() never meets an old threshold again. The retention job runs the three new steps, each with
 * its audit row. Every test runs in a transaction that is rolled back, as the migrator, who alone moves times back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: retention of orders and messages", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const log = pino({ level: "silent" });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  const due = async (tx: DbTx) => (await tx.execute<{ order_id: string }>(sql`select order_id::text from public.order_records_due()`)).map((row) => row.order_id);
  const erase = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) => tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.erase_order_records(${orderId}::uuid) as n`).then((rows) => rows[0]!.n);
  const deleteMessages = (tx: DbTx, days: number) =>
    tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.delete_contact_messages(now() - make_interval(days => ${days})) as n`).then((rows) => rows[0]!.n);
  const count = async (tx: DbTx, query: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from (${query}) q`))[0]!.n;
  /** A message as the watcher records it, received some days ago, and handled some days ago when a disposition is given. */
  async function message(tx: DbTx, receivedDaysAgo: number, handled?: { disposition: string; daysAgo: number }, stale = false): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, seen_at, stale, disposition, handled_by, handled_at)
      values ('inbox', ${randomInt(1, 2 ** 31)}, 1, now() - make_interval(days => ${receivedDaysAgo}), now() - make_interval(days => ${receivedDaysAgo}), ${stale},
              ${handled?.disposition ?? null}, ${handled ? moderator.id : null}::uuid, ${handled ? sql`now() - make_interval(days => ${handled.daysAgo})` : null})
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;

    const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
    const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC });
    return { view: await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order)), postId: p.postId, authorId: p.authorId };
  }
  const reinstate = (tx: DbTx, view: OrderView) =>

  test("an order's records are due three years after its newest event, never while its measure stands, and are erased whole while the ledger stays", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // The message the order came in, handled as an order (insertOrder marks it so for the API's role).
      const msg = await message(tx, 1, { disposition: "order", daysAgo: 0 });
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], messageId: msg });
      const view = await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      const item = view.items[0]!;
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, PAST_THE_RECORDS);
      // The measure stands (and so would its preservation): never due, however old.
      expect(await due(tx)).not.toContain(order.id);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => erase(sp, order.id)))).toBe("not_due");
      const correction = await reinstate(tx, view);
      // The reinstatement is the newest event: two years later, still not due.

      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, PAST_THE_RECORDS);
      expect(await due(tx)).toContain(order.id);

      const events = await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      expect(await erase(tx, order.id)).toBe(events + 1 + 1 + 1);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.legal_orders where id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe(0);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe(0);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`)).toBe(0);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.contact_messages where id = ${msg}::uuid`)).toBe(0);
      // The ledger stays, its decisions no longer naming the item.
      const ledger = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; item: string | null }>(
        sql`select d.kind::text as kind, d.order_item_id::text as item from public.decisions d where d.id in (${item.decisionId!}::uuid, ${correction}::uuid) order by d.decided_at`,
      );
      expect(ledger.map((row) => [row.kind, row.item])).toEqual([
        ["order", null],
        ["correction", null],
      ]);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.decision_actions where decision_id in (${item.decisionId!}::uuid, ${correction}::uuid)`)).toBe(2);

      // Both decisions still read: the notice says only that an order was given effect, and when.
      for (const id of [item.decisionId!, correction]) {
        const found = (await decisionStatement(tx as unknown as Db, id))!;
        expect(found.statement.order).toBeNull();
        const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
        expect(paragraphs.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(paragraphs).toContain(ORDER_NOTICE.recordsDeleted.gone);
        expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/Bundeskriminalamt|T-/);
        const view = await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), p.authorId, id);
        expect(statementParagraphs(view, { texts: view.orderTexts ?? null, erasedOn: view.erasedOn ?? null })).toEqual(paragraphs);
      }
    });
  });

  test("an untold decision about one of its posts keeps an order's records, and so does a running hold, however old", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const { view } = await given(tx, true);
      await reinstate(tx, view);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, view.id, PAST_THE_RECORDS);
      // Both the order decision and the correction are held with the notice: informed_at null.
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.decisions d where d.case_id = ${view.items[0]!.caseId!}::uuid and d.informed_at is null`)).toBe(2);
      expect(await due(tx)).not.toContain(view.id);
    });
  });

  test("an order nothing acted on is due three years after it was opened, and not before", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, (ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears * 365 - 2) * DAY);
      expect(await due(tx)).not.toContain(order.id);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, 10 * DAY);
      expect(await due(tx)).toContain(order.id);
      expect(await erase(tx, order.id)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    });
  });

  test("a message is deleted 30 days after it was handled; an unhandled one, stale or not, never; an order's message goes with the order", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => deleteMessages(sp, ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays - 1)))).toBe("not_due");
      const handledLong = await message(tx, 40, { disposition: "not_an_order", daysAgo: ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays + 1 });
      const handledLately = await message(tx, 40, { disposition: "referral", daysAgo: ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays - 1 });

      const ordered = await message(tx, 400, { disposition: "order", daysAgo: 400 });

      expect([await left(handledLong), await left(handledLately), await left(unhandled), await left(stale), await left(ordered)]).toEqual([0, 1, 1, 1, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("old outbox rows go unless their subject is open, so alert_steps() never writes an order_due again for a deadline long past", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {

      const unhandled = await message(tx, 40);

      expect(openRows).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, open.id, 40 * DAY);
      const doneMsg = await message(tx, 1, { disposition: "order", daysAgo: 1 });

      await ageOrderForTest(tx, done.id, 40 * DAY);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${done.id}::uuid and created_at < now() - interval '30 days'`)).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      await deleteMessages(tx, ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, unhandled)).map((row) => [row.kind, row.step])).toEqual(written);
      expect(await outboxOf(tx, handled)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${open.id}::uuid`)).toBe(openRows);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${done.id}::uuid and created_at < now() - interval '30 days'`)).toBe(0);

      // Nothing is written again for the deadline long past: the kept rows still answer for it.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);

      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${open.id}::uuid`)).toBe(openRows);
      // Had they gone, alert_steps() would have met the old threshold again and rung every phone at priority 5.
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id = ${unhandled}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, unhandled)).map((row) => row.kind)).toContain("order_due");
    });
  });

  test("the retention job runs order_preservation, order_records and contact_messages, each with its audit row", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const start = (await tx.execute<{ seq: number }>(sql`select seq::int as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`))[0]!.seq;
      const preserved = await given(tx);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, preserved.view.id, 200 * DAY);
      const old = await given(tx);
      await reinstate(tx, old.view);
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, old.view.id, PAST_THE_RECORDS);
      await message(tx, 40, { disposition: "not_an_order", daysAgo: ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays + 1 });

      const report = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log });
      expect(report.preservations).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(report.orderRecords).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(report.contactMessages).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(report.failed).toBe(0);
      const rows = (
        await tx.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown>; actor_id: string; step_up: unknown }>(
          sql`select metadata, actor_id, step_up from public.audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${start} order by chain_seq`,
        )
      ).map((row) => row.metadata);
      expect(rows).toContainEqual({ step: "order_preservation", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, itemId: preserved.view.items[0]!.id, erased: true, count: 1 });
      expect(rows).toContainEqual({ step: "order_records", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, orderId: old.view.id, count: expect.any(Number) });
      expect(rows.some((row) => row.step === "contact_messages")).toBe(true);
      // The steps come before the disposal, which then takes the erased post's image rows.
      const steps = rows.map((row) => row.step);
      expect(steps.indexOf("order_preservation")).toBeLessThan(steps.lastIndexOf("images") === -1 ? Infinity : steps.lastIndexOf("images"));
      const [post] = await tx.execute<{ level: string; body: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level, body from public.posts where id = ${preserved.postId}::uuid`);
      expect([post!.level, post!.body]).toEqual(["removed", ""]);
      expect(await count(tx, sql`select 1 from public.legal_orders where id = ${old.view.id}::uuid`)).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
} from "@korbat/contracts";

import {

  CASE_QUOTED,

  frozenCase,

  sealableCase,

} from "../case-fixtures";
import { HOSTILE } from "../fixtures";

/**
 * The staff API as the browser check answers it (3a design, section 12): no database and no API process, only answers
 * from fixtures held in memory, shaped by the contracts, whose user-written strings are hostile. It checks what a real
 * browser sends, as far as the console's part goes: the staff gate's Host, Origin and fetch metadata, the staff CSRF
 * header on every write, the WebAuthn ceremonies' client data (type, challenge, origin) and the authenticator's flags
 * (user verified, never backup-eligible or backed up). Anything the page sent that the real API would refuse for the
 * page's own fault is listed in `problems`. Signatures are not verified: the API's own tests do that with its library.
 *
 * A decision (3c design, section 7.5) is checked as far as the page's own part goes: the assertion was made over a
 * challenge bound to exactly the params the request carries, the snapshot it names is the case's newest with the digest
 * of what the page was shown, recomputed here, and each text it names is one the page saved on that case. The case is
 * then changed as the decision says, and answered as it now stands.
 *
 * A review (section 7.7) is checked the same way: the assertion was made over a challenge bound to exactly this review of
 * exactly this decision, its appeal is the decision's pending one, its snapshot the case's newest as shown, and its
 * reason one the page saved on that case. The appeals' list answers what waits in the fixtures' cases, without a
 * statement.
 *
 * A text is saved without the key (section 7.4), also when its field loses focus: every save is kept, so the walk counts
 * them, and a case's answer carries the person's saved texts that no decision has named yet, as the API's does, so that a
 * reload brings them back. A step of the walk can have the next save refused, a case decided by another staff member
 * behind the page, the person made an admin, and a saved draft answered with other words under its digest.
 */

/** The longest handle an account can choose (checkHandle: 3 to 20 of a-z, 0-9 and _). */
export const LONGEST_HANDLE = "h".repeat(20);

/** The name typed for the new key at enrolment: markup, within the display-name rules the page checks it against. */
export const TYPED_KEY_NAME = '"><img src=x onerror=alert(9)>';

/** The signed-in person's handle, and the browser labels of their sessions, as an API made to echo them would send them. */
export const PERSON_HANDLE = HOSTILE.script;
export const CURRENT_BROWSER = HOSTILE.url;
export const OTHER_BROWSERS = [HOSTILE.img, HOSTILE.bidi] as const;
/** The keys the person already holds, by name: the longest name allowed (50 characters), and more markup. */
export const EXISTING_KEY_NAMES = [HOSTILE.long, HOSTILE.quote] as const;
/** The handles the audit log's rows name, in turn; null is the system actor. */
export const ACTOR_HANDLES = [HOSTILE.script, HOSTILE.img, HOSTILE.url, HOSTILE.quote, HOSTILE.bidi, LONGEST_HANDLE, null] as const;

/** 3e Task 4: the handle of the Standing screen's account at the ladder's strikes, on which the walk opens a case. */
export const STANDING_HANDLE = "lad_der";

export const REVEALED_HANDLE = '"><a href="javascript:alert(5)">a_reporter</a>';

/** The reason a forged save answer stands for: one the person never wrote. */

export const TYPED_REASON = `The withhold was taken on the wrong post ${HOSTILE.img}`;
export const TYPED_FACTS = `The post offers followers for money ${HOSTILE.quote}`;
export const TYPED_REVIEW_REASON = `The rule does not cover a quotation ${HOSTILE.quote}`;
```
