```ts
 * transaction with the 10-second lock timeout, the order's row first, its event via `cli` and its audit row
 * order_recorded last under the system actor, never a text in the audit row but its digest; a refusal is one sentence
 * ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. order-open writes the console's rows through insertOrder with
 * the receipt it is given, its alert order_opened before its audit row, and refuses without HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN. An
 * order is named by its id or as <CC>:<reference>, order_ambiguous when several share it; an instant has its offset.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the order commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staff: TestStaff;
  let author: { id: string };

  let before: Record<string, number>;

  const messages: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();
  // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
  let appOrigin: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    staff = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, staff);
    author = await newProfile(w.apiDb);
    // Counted once the staff and the profiles stand: they leave in afterAll, after the last count.
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, orders);
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [staff.id, author.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
    await w.close();
  });

  const env = (extra: Record<string, string> = {}) => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin, ...extra });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], options: { env?: Record<string, string>; input?: string | Buffer } = {}) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const input = async () => (options.input === undefined ? Buffer.alloc(0) : Buffer.isBuffer(options.input) ? options.input : Buffer.from(options.input, "utf8"));
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, options.env ?? env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, input);
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  const orderRow = async (id: string) => (await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.legal_orders where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;

  test("order-open: the console's rows with the receipt it is given, the alert order_opened and its audit row as the system actor; without HOME_STATE or APP_ORIGIN it refuses", async () => {

    expect(opened.lines).toEqual([`out order-open: order ${id} opened: tco_removal, FR, reference ${reference}, 2 items (1 name no post). Receipt: ${received.toISOString()}; deadline ${deadline}.`]);
    const row = await orderRow(id);
    expect([row.opened_via, row.opened_by, row.cross_border, row.section_c, row.withhold_from_author, row.preserve, row.channel]).toEqual(["cli", null, true, true, true, true, "post"]);
    expect(await eventsOf(id)).toEqual([["opened", null, "cli"]]);
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: Record<string, unknown>; mailed: boolean }>(

    const again = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "tco_removal", "--state", "FR", "--authority", "Office central", "--reference", reference, "--channel", "post", "--link", "https://e.example/y"]);
    expect([again.code, again.text]).toEqual([1, "err order-open: an order of this authority with this reference is already recorded (order_exists); nothing changed"]);
    // Without a receipt: the console says deadline unknown.
    const unknown = await cli(["order-open", "--kind", "tco_removal", "--state", "DE", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", `U-${randomUUID()}`, "--channel", "other", "--link", "https://e.example/u"]);
    orders.push(/order ([0-9a-f-]{36}) opened/.exec(unknown.text)![1]!);
    expect(unknown.text).toMatch(/Receipt not recorded: the console says deadline unknown[.]$/);
  });

  test("order-open from a listed message: the message's receipt, the channel mailbox, the message handled as an order", async () => {

    );
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id])).text).toBe("err order-tell-rule: the home state's default is never; give --when to record a rule; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id, "--when", "never", "--basis", "TDDDG s. 22"])).text).toBe("out order-tell-rule: the person is told never, on the basis recorded.");
    expect((await cli(["order-told", info.id, "--at", new Date().toISOString(), "--how", "mail"])).text).toBe("err order-told: the rule recorded for this order is that the person is never told; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", info.id, "--when", "at_effect", "--basis", "the order's sentence 3"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect((await cli(["order-told", info.id, "--at", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "mail from the contact address"])).text).toMatch(/^out order-told: recorded at /);
    const removal = await consoleOrder();
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", removal.id, "--when", "never", "--basis", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
  });

  test("an order named as <CC>:<reference> while several orders of the state share it is order_ambiguous, naming each by its id", async () => {
    const reference = `AMB-${randomUUID()}`;
    const one = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference, authority: "Authority one", links: ["https://e.example/a1"] });
    const two = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference, authority: "Authority two", links: ["https://e.example/a2"] });
    orders.push(one.id, two.id);
    const named = await cli(["order-verify", `DE:${reference}`, "--how", "x"]);
    expect(named.code).toBe(1);
    expect(named.text).toContain(`err order_ambiguous: 2 orders of DE have this reference; name one by its id:`);
    expect(named.text).toContain(one.id);
    expect(named.text).toContain(two.id);
    expect(named.text).toMatch(/nothing changed$/);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {

    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));

    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);

});

/**
 * The preservation's two commands (3f design, sections 7.11, 8.11 and 10.5; Task 4): order-preserve-extend moves an
 * item's preserve_until forward on an authority's or a court's request, never back, and is refused once the
 * preservation ended (not_preserved); its event preservation_extended names the item and its audit row order_recorded
 * holds the request's facts, the proceedings only as a digest. order-access prints the preserved snapshot's text, its
 * alt texts and the images' ids, sizes and creation times, never an image, and records the access as preserved_accessed
 * with the purpose and the counts; an access for an authority is recorded with its production, which Task 5 builds, so
 * it is refused until then. The effect commits with a real key; the last test removes what the block made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the preservation's commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let appOrigin: string;
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const people: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(w.apiDb);
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  async function cli(args: string[]) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const env = { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin };
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.alloc(0));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  /** A post with two images under a removal order given effect with the moderator's real key: its item. */
  async function preserved(): Promise<{ itemId: string; orderId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[] }> {
    const p = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    people.push(p.authorId);
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
    const outcome = await effectForTest(world, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return { itemId: outcome.items[0]!.id, orderId: order.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
  }
  const item = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ until: string; ended: string | null }>(
      sql`select to_char(preserve_until at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as until, preserve_ended_at::text as ended from public.legal_order_items where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;
  const lastAudit = async (targetId: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${targetId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;
  const digest = (text: string) => createHash("sha256").update(text, "utf8").digest("hex");

  test("the usage lists both commands", () => {
    for (const command of ["order-preserve-extend", "order-access"]) expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
  });

  test("order-preserve-extend moves preserve_until forward, records the request, and is refused backwards, without a flag and once the preservation ended", async () => {
    const { itemId, orderId } = await preserved();
    const was = (await item(itemId)).until;
    const later = new Date(Date.parse(was) + 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString();
    const received = new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000).toISOString();
    const args = (until: string) => ["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", until, "--by", "Landgericht Berlin", "--reference", "AZ 501/26", "--proceedings", "review of the removal order", "--received", received];
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(was) - 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(`err order-preserve-extend: --until is not later than the preservation's end, ${was}; nothing changed`);
    expect((await cli(["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", later, "--by", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    const done = await cli(args(later));
    expect(done.text).toBe(`out order-preserve-extend: item ${itemId} is preserved until ${later} (was ${was}).`);
    expect((await item(itemId)).until).toBe(later);
    const [event] = await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; via: string; effective: string }>(
      sql`select kind, via, to_char(effective_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as effective from public.legal_order_events where item_id = ${itemId}::uuid and kind = 'preservation_extended'`,
    );
    expect([event!.kind, event!.via, event!.effective]).toEqual(["preservation_extended", "cli", received]);
    const audit = await lastAudit(orderId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["order_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ event: "preservation_extended", itemId, until: later, was, received, by: "Landgericht Berlin", reference: "AZ 501/26", proceedingsSha256: digest("review of the removal order") });
    // Once the preservation ended (here by hand, as the migrator), nothing moves it.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_ended_at = now() where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(later) + 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(
      `err order-preserve-extend: not_preserved: item ${itemId} is not preserved, or its preservation has ended; nothing changed`,
    );
  });

  test("order-access prints the preserved text, alt texts and image facts, never an image, and records the access; an authority's access waits for its production", async () => {
    const { itemId, mediaIds } = await preserved();
    const done = await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "review", "--for", "the court asked to see it"]);
    expect(done.code).toBe(0);
    expect(done.lines[0]).toBe("out order-access: recorded, purpose review.");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out a post");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out order-access: alt text of image 1: image 1");
    for (const id of mediaIds) expect(done.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`order-access: image ${id}: 1200 x 800 pixels, created [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T`));
    const audit = await lastAudit(itemId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["preserved_accessed", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order_item"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ purpose: "review", productionId: null, forSha256: digest("the court asked to see it"), images: 2, altTexts: 2, textLength: 6 });
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "authority", "--for", "BKA"])).text).toBe(
      "err order-access: an access for an authority is recorded with its production, which this server cannot record yet; nothing changed",
    );
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "curiosity", "--for", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-access", randomUUID(), "--purpose", "review", "--for", "x"])).text).toMatch(/^err order-access: not_preserved: /);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeDecided(world.migrateDb, posts, [moderator.id]);
    await removeOrderAlerts(world.migrateDb, started);
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, people);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

    config = loadConfig();

    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore(() => now().getTime());
    const auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), now });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social });

  afterAll(async () => {

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account. Accounts are as old as the clock offset says. */
  async function signUp() {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);

    const handle = `s${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;

    expect(start.status).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    return { b, handle };

  const json = async (res: Response) => res.json() as Promise<unknown>;

    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(200);

    expect((await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);

    await liftRowForTest(migrateDb, row!.id);

    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const ada = await signUp();
    const made = [];

    const second = TimelinePage.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/timeline/latest?limit=2&cursor=${encodeURIComponent(first.nextCursor!)}`)));

  });

  // 3f (design, section 7.12; invariant 19): the status of a post's page, which Caddy asks for /post/*, follows what a
  // signed-out read of the post answers: 204 while it is public, 404 once its author deleted it, with no body either way.
  test("a post's status is 204 while a signed-out read shows it, and 404 once its author deleted it", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const ada = await signUp();
    const made = await post(ada.b, "a post whose page is checked");
    const asked = await app.request(`/api/posts/${made.id}/status`);
    expect([asked.status, await asked.text()]).toEqual([204, ""]);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/posts/${made.id}`)).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${made.id}`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    const gone = await app.request(`/api/posts/${made.id}/status`);
    expect([gone.status, await gone.text()]).toEqual([404, ""]);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/posts/${made.id}`)).status).toBe(404);
  });
});
```

```ts
const SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };
const SEAL_FOR_GOOD: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };

/**
 * Every method of the media repository, in one record (3c design, section 12). A method that deletes image rows is run
 * against a frozen post below; a method that gives an image, or what an image is, to someone is run against sealed
 * images; and a method that does neither says why. The record is typed over the repository's methods and compared with
 * them at run time, so a method added to createMediaRepo fails this file until whoever adds it has said which it is,
 * and a new deleter or reader fails it until it has a run of its own.
 */
type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {
  accountCreatedAt: { is: "neither", why: "reads when an account was onboarded, and no image row" },
  pendingCount: { is: "neither", why: "counts an account's uploads that are on no post" },
  insertProcessing: { is: "neither", why: "inserts an upload on no post" },
  find: { is: "reader" },
  finalize: { is: "neither", why: "records the worker's verdict on an upload that is still processing" },
  deleteUnattached: { is: "deleter" },
  fileAccess: { is: "reader" },
  attach: { is: "neither", why: "puts its author's own upload on a new post" },
  detachAll: { is: "deleter" },
  purgeOwner: { is: "deleter" },
  forPosts: { is: "reader" },
  readyImages: { is: "reader" },
  isExportable: { is: "reader" },
  processingIds: { is: "neither", why: "lists uploads that are still processing, which are on no post" },
  failStale: { is: "neither", why: "fails uploads that are still processing, which are on no post" },
  deleteUnattachedBefore: { is: "deleter" },
  existing: { is: "neither", why: "says which ids have a row, to the reconcile pass, and must see every row" },
  deleteRow: { is: "deleter" },
  hold: { is: "neither", why: "locks image rows and places holds; what it answers is text and sizes for a case's snapshot" },
  reach: { is: "neither", why: "answers counts, a day and a time, never an id or anything of an image" },
  staffAccess: { is: "reader" },
  dropDisposable: { is: "deleter" },
  overdueDeletions: { is: "neither", why: "answers how many rows the disposal should have taken by now" },
  moderationStates: { is: "neither", why: "answers each attached row's id, post, stored state and erasure time to text-verify, and nothing of an image itself" },
  // 3f, Task 2: opening an order takes an image's address as its post, and an order's screen counts a post's images.
  imagePost: { is: "neither", why: "answers which post an image id is attached to, for an order's item, and nothing of the image" },
  imageCounts: { is: "neither", why: "answers how many image rows each post holds, for an order's screen, and nothing of an image" },
  preservedImages: { is: "neither", why: "answers a preserved post's image ids, pixel sizes and creation times for order-access, never a file or its content" },
};
const methodsThatAre = (role: Role["is"]) => (Object.keys(METHODS) as (keyof MediaRepo)[]).filter((name) => METHODS[name].is === role).sort();

/** What a deleter is run on: the repository on the test's transaction, and the frozen post with its author and images. */
interface Frozen {
  repo: MediaRepo;
  tx: DbTx;
  ownerId: string;

}

/** Each deleter run as hard as it can be against the post's images; it answers the ids it says are gone. */
const DELETERS = {

    const gone: string[] = [];
    for (const id of f.mediaIds) if (await f.repo.deleteUnattached(id, f.ownerId)) gone.push(id);
    return gone;
  },
  detachAll: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.detachAll(f.tx, f.postId),
  purgeOwner: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.purgeOwner(f.tx, f.ownerId),
  // Every upload on no post that is older than tomorrow: every one there is.
  deleteUnattachedBefore: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.deleteUnattachedBefore(new Date(Date.now() + DAY)),
  deleteRow: async (f: Frozen) => {
    for (const id of f.mediaIds) await f.repo.deleteRow(id);
    return [] as string[];
  },
  // Batch after batch until one is not full: everything that is disposable now.
  dropDisposable: async (f: Frozen) => {
    const gone: string[] = [];
    for (;;) {
      const batch = await f.repo.dropDisposable(f.tx, 500);
      gone.push(...batch);
      if (batch.length < 500) return gone;
    }
  },
} satisfies Partial<Record<keyof MediaRepo, (f: Frozen) => Promise<string[]>>>;

        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);
      const strangerReply = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply by someone else", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const reply = await newPost(w.s.repo, author!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply with an image", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const replyImage = await w.h.readyImage(author!.id);
      await w.tx.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${reply}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'a reply image' where id = ${replyImage}::uuid`);
      const quoting = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "look at this", { quoteOfId: top.postId });
      const ranked = await newPostRow(w.tx, author!.id, { createdAt: sql`${earlier(asOf, 2 * HOUR).toISOString()}::timestamptz` });
      const rankedImage = await newImageRow(w.tx, author!.id, ranked, 0);
      await likedBy(w.s.repo, ranked, fans as { id: string }[], earlier(asOf, HOUR));
      // A round writes nothing while a ranking as new as its own time exists, and other suites leave theirs behind:
      // inside this transaction, which is rolled back, there is none.
      await w.tx.execute(sql`delete from explore_runs`);
      await rank(w.s.repo, asOf);
      for (const reader of [author!, other!]) {
        expect(await w.s.repo.like(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
        expect(await w.s.repo.bookmark(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(await w.s.repo.follow(other!.id, author!.id, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      return { author: author!, other: other!, top, strangerReply, reply, replyImage, quoting, ranked, rankedImage };
    }
    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },
        { name: "a thread's own post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).post.media },
        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a thread's reply", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).replies.items, f.reply) },
        { name: "the Latest timeline", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await latestTimeline(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
    async function everyList(w: World, f: Scene, check: (answer: Listed, images: string[], viewer: string | null, label: string) => void) {
      for (const list of lists(w, f)) {
        for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) {
          if (viewer === null && list.signedIn) continue;
          if (list.onlyFor && viewer !== list.onlyFor) continue;
          check(await list.read(viewer), list.images, viewer, `${list.name}, read by ${viewer === f.author.id ? "the author" : viewer === null ? "nobody signed in" : "another account"}`);
        }
      }
    }
    test("a frozen post whose images are not sealed: staff are refused, and every other reader is unchanged", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const f = await scene(w);
        await report(w.tx, anAccount(f.author.id, f.author.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, f.top.postId)).toBe(true);

        let read = 0;
        await everyList(w, f, (answer, images, _viewer, label) => {
          read++;
          expect(answer, label).toEqual(images.map(whole));
          expect(answer!.some((image) => "hidden" in image), label).toBe(false);
        });
        // Twelve lists: nine for every reader, likes and bookmarks for the two accounts, Following for the one who follows.
        expect(read).toBe(9 * 3 + 2 * 2 + 1);
        for (const id of f.top.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) expect(await ask(w, id, viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "public, max-age=300" });
          expect(await status(w.h.deps, f.author.id, id)).toMatchObject({ status: "ready", blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" });
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(f.author.id, id)).toBe(true);
        }

        const media = async (viewer: string | null) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, viewer, p.postId)).media;

        for (const viewer of [bob.id, null]) expect(await media(viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual([{ id: first, hidden: true }, whole(second), whole(third)]);

        writeFileSync(w.h.files.store.image(second, "large"), webpBytes("VP8X", 2048, 1536));
        expect(await staffOpens(w, second)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    expect(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(authCounts);
  });
});
```

```ts
  function recordingMedia(onRequest?: (ids: readonly string[]) => Promise<void>): { media: MediaForCases; events: string[]; requested: string[][] } {

    expect(named("redaction", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "redaction", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 1 }]);
    expect(named("statements", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "statements", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 2 }]);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["drafts", "access_log", "images"]));
    // In the order of the steps: the drafts first, the images last.
    expect(rows[0]!.metadata.step).toBe("drafts");
    expect(rows.at(-1)!.metadata).toEqual({ step: "images", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 });

    // Nothing is late any more, and a second round changes nothing and writes nothing.
    now += ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS + 1;
    expect(await late()).toEqual({ ...baseline, contacts: 0 });
    const after = await head();
    expect(await round(casesMedia(apiDb))).toEqual({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, redactions: 0, statements: 0, replies: 0, reportCounts: 0, preservations: 0, orderRecords: 0, contactMessages: 0, accessLog: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await head()).toBe(after);
  });

  test.each(["its author's account", "its author's purged account", "the post itself, by the item korbat adds for a quoted post"] as const)(
    "a closed case holding the images of a post its author then deleted, due while the post is frozen through %s: every step of a round leaves its snapshot and its image rows, its notes go and its holds are released, and no file is requested; after an answer without a seal the next round takes them",
    async (reach) => {
    const f = await post(2);
    const closed = await reported(aPost(f.postId));
    decided(await w.decideAs(mod, closed.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    await saveText(apiDb, closed.caseId, mod.id, "note");
    await authorDeletes(f.postId, "3 days");
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, closed.caseId, "3 days");
    // The report of child sexual abuse material that freezes the post: about its author's account (purged or not), or about
    // a post of someone else that quotes it, which brings an item of its own for the quoted post.
    let suspectCases: string[];
    if (reach.startsWith("the post")) {
      const quoter = await newProfile(apiDb);
      profilesMade.push(quoter.id);
      const quoting = await newPostRow(apiDb, quoter.id, { quoteOfId: f.postId });
      const made = await reported(aPost(quoting), "csam");
      suspectCases = made.recorded.items.map((item) => item.caseId!);
      expect(suspectCases).toHaveLength(2);
    } else {
      if (reach.includes("purged")) await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set display_name = 'Deleted account', bio = '', deleted_at = now() - interval '3 days' where id = ${f.authorId}::uuid`);
      suspectCases = [(await reported(anAccount(f.authorId), "csam")).caseId];
    }

    const first = recordingMedia();
    const start = await head();
    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 1, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: closed.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    // The case holds only a snapshot of a frozen post now: it is no candidate, nothing is late, and a round leaves it alone.
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 10 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect({ caseEvidence: counts.caseEvidence, images: counts.images }).toEqual({ caseEvidence: 0, images: 0 });
    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);

    // An admin answers the report without a seal: the freeze ends. Two days on, the answered cases' own evidence is due
    // too (the case of the post itself held the images for that long), and one round takes everything.
    for (const id of suspectCases) {
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, id, "2 days");
    }
    const second = recordingMedia();
    expect(await round(second.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1 + suspectCases.length, batches: [2], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
    expect(second.requested.flat().sort()).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    },
  );

  test("a row that raises is rolled back alone with no audit row, is logged with its step and its id, and never stops another row; the count of what is late names it", async () => {
    // A decision whose subject's profile says deleted 13 months ago while its auth row is live: the job names it, the database refuses it.
    const p = await post(0);
    const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
    const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months 2 days' where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
    await authAccount(w.migrateDb, p.authorId);
    authRowsMade.push(p.authorId);
    // And a draft of three days ago, which the same round still deletes.
    const draft = await saveText(apiDb, made.caseId, mod.id, "reason", "an old draft");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update staff_texts set created_at = now() - interval '3 days' where digest = ${draft}`);

    const lines: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    const logging = pino({ level: "info" }, { write: (line: string) => void lines.push(JSON.parse(line) as Record<string, unknown>) });
    const start = await head();
    const done = await retentionRound({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), log: logging });
    expect(done).toMatchObject({ statements: 0, failed: 1 });
    expect(done.drafts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const failures = lines.filter((line) => line.level === 50);
    expect(failures).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(failures[0]).toMatchObject({ job: "moderation-retention", step: "statements", decisionId: removal });
    // No log line of the round carries an address, a handle or an account id.
    expect(JSON.stringify(lines)).not.toContain(p.authorId);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(["drafts"]);
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${made.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 20 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect(counts.statements).toBe(1);
    // The mark comes off the profile again, so that the rounds of the other tests are not held to this refusal.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = null where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
  });

  describe("MODERATION_RETENTION", () => {
    /** A lock that says which keys were asked for, and resolves when one is let go. */
    function watchedLock() {
      const inner = new MemoryJobLock();
      const asked: string[] = [];
      const released = new Map<string, () => void>();
      const lock: JobLock = {
        acquire: (key, token, ttlMs) => {
          asked.push(key);
          return inner.acquire(key, token, ttlMs);
        },
        refresh: (key, token, ttlMs) => inner.refresh(key, token, ttlMs),
        release: async (key, token) => {
          await inner.release(key, token);
          released.get(key)?.();
        },
      };
      const until = (key: string) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => released.set(key, resolve));
      return { lock, asked, until };
    }

    test.each(["off", "on"] as const)("%s: after ten minutes the dispatch job's round runs, and the retention job's only while the switch is on; off, the warning is logged and a due case keeps its snapshot and a due R4 decision's post its body", async (setting) => {
      const p = await post(0);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      const state = async () => ({
        ...(await one<{ body: string; redacted: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select (select body from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid) as body, (select redacted_at is not null from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid) as redacted`)),
        snapshots: (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, made.caseId)).snapshots,
      });
      expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 });

      const warnings: string[] = [];
      const logger = pino({ level: "warn" }, { write: (line: string) => void warnings.push((JSON.parse(line) as { msg: string }).msg) });
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: { ...loadConfig(), MODERATION_RETENTION: setting }, logger });
      const { lock, asked, until } = watchedLock();
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] });
      let stop: () => void = () => undefined;
      try {
        stop = moderation.startJobs(lock);
        expect(warnings.filter((line) => line === RETENTION_OFF_WARNING)).toHaveLength(setting === "off" ? 1 : 0);
        expect(RETENTION_OFF_WARNING).toBe("moderation-retention: off (MODERATION_RETENTION)");
        const dispatched = until("job:moderation-dispatch");
        const retained = setting === "on" ? until("job:moderation-retention") : Promise.resolve();
        // Nothing of these two runs before the ten minutes are over. 3f's alert tick, which startJobs also starts in
        // both branches, runs every 30 seconds meanwhile.
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
        expect(asked.filter((key) => key !== "job:alert-tick")).toEqual([]);
        expect(asked).toContain("job:alert-tick");
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2);
        await Promise.all([dispatched, retained]);
      } finally {
        stop();
        vi.useRealTimers();
      }
      expect(asked).toContain("job:moderation-dispatch");
      expect(asked.includes("job:moderation-retention")).toBe(setting === "on");
      expect(await state()).toEqual(setting === "off" ? { body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 } : { body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      // The author's decision screen: the copy while korbat holds it, and after the job's redaction the words of an R4 erasure.
      expect((await authorDecisionView({ apiDb }, p.authorId, removal)).content!.kind).toBe(setting === "off" ? "post" : "r4_redacted");
      // What the switch held back is made up by a round once it is on again.
      if (setting === "off") {
        await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
        expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  describe("the purge's forgetting", () => {
    test("forgetAccount forgets the reports of an account the take-down marked deleted, changes nothing for a live one, and nothing when run again", async () => {
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: loadConfig(), logger: log });
      const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(w.authDb));
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${`r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`}, 'Reporter')`);
      profilesMade.push(user.id);
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await recordIntake(moderation.deps, { ground: ground.rule(user.id), live: [aPost(p.postId)] });
      const linked = () => one(apiDb, sql`select (select reporter_id from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid) as intake, (select reporter_account_id from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid) as item`);

      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: user.id, item: user.id });
      // The take-down's mark, as the auth role sets it; from then on the purge's step forgets the links.
      await w.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${user.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      // The report goes on: its item still waits in its case.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid and outcome is null and case_id is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  describe("the erasures' races", () => {
    /** A signed-out notice of illegality about a new post, answered without action and released `ago` ago: no account stands on its items. */
    async function releasedNotice(ago: string) {
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      decided(await w.decideAs(mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId);
      await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId, ago);
      return { ...p, caseId, intakeId: recorded.intakeId, itemId: recorded.items[0]!.id };
    }
    /** The re-examination's item, as the intake transaction inserts it, in a new open case of the post. */
    const reexamine = (db: Parameters<typeof insertItem>[0], n: { intakeId: string; postId: string; itemId: string }, caseId: string, marker?: string) =>
      insertItem(db, { intakeId: n.intakeId, caseId, targetId: n.postId, lane: 1, reexaminesItemId: n.itemId, marker });
    const openCaseOf = async (postId: string) => (await one<{ id: string }>(apiDb, sql`insert into cases (target_type, target_id) values ('post', ${postId}::uuid) returning id`)).id;

    test("a re-examination that holds the intake first makes the erasure wait, and the erasure then finds the intake not due", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("5 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let erasing: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The re-examination is inside its window, and its transaction holds the intake's row.
        await reexamine(tx, n, caseId);
        // Meanwhile the window runs out: without the new item the intake's record would be due.
        await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, n.intakeId, "8 months");
        erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid)`));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await erasing).toBe("not_due");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is null as held, explanation is not null as words from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ held: true, words: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("an erasure that holds the intake first makes the re-examination wait, and the re-examination is then refused: nothing is asked of an erased record", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("8 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let asking: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid) as n`)).toMatchObject({ n: expect.any(Number) });
        // The item's release is dated forward again while the erasure is still open: by the clock alone the window
        // would be open, so only the erased record refuses the request.
        await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now() - interval '5 months' where id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`);
        asking = refusal(reexamine(apiDb, n, caseId, marker));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await asking).toBe("reexamination_not_open");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is not null as erased from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ erased: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
    });

    /** A post removed under R1 seven months ago: its restriction is final for its author, and its case's evidence is due. */
    async function dueRemoval() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, caseId: made.caseId, removal };
    }
    const snapshotErased = async (caseId: string) => (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, caseId)).snapshots === 0;

    test("a correction that names the old snapshot and takes the case first commits before the erasure, which then erases the snapshot", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const release = gate();
      const held = gate();
      // Another session holds the post's row, which the correction's measure needs after it has taken the case.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from posts where id = ${r.postId}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decision_actions (decision_id");
      const erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`));
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      release.open();
      await holding;
      const correction = decided(await correcting);
      expect(await erasing).toBeNull();
      // The correction committed naming a snapshot that was whole at its commit; the erasure came after it.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid) <= (select erased_at from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid) as before`)).toEqual({ before: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
    });

    test("an erasure that takes the case first erases the snapshot, and the correction that named it is refused: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`);
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the case, and that already waits for the erasure, which holds the case's row.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into staff_texts (case_id");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("a correction that names a snapshot taken in the last day commits, and the erasure is refused: the case is not due for a day", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const fresh = await one<{ id: string; digest: string }>(w.migrateDb, sql`
        insert into evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
        select case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid returning id, digest`);
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")], snapshotId: fresh.id, snapshotDigest: fresh.digest }));
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      expect((await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r.caseId)).snapshots).toBe(2);
    });

    /**
     * A post with one image and two closed cases. The earlier one removed the image under R1 eight months ago, and its copy
     * of the post was taken then. The later one removed the post under R4 seven months ago: that removal is final for its
     * author, so its redaction is due, and the earlier case's copy, taken before it, holds what it restricted.
     */
    async function dueRedaction() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const earlier = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const imageRemoval = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, earlier.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", p.mediaIds[0]!)] }));
      const later = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, later.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, earlier.caseId, "8 months");
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, later.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, earlier: earlier.caseId, imageRemoval, later: later.caseId, removal };
    }

    test("the R4 redaction takes every case whose copy it erases before it erases one: it waits for a transaction that holds an earlier case of the post, as a decision on that case does, and erases that case's copy only afterwards", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // A decision takes its case's row in this mode before it reads the copy it names.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from cases where id = ${r.earlier}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const redacting = one<{ changed: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`);
      try {
        // The redaction either comes to wait, or ends without waiting: then it erased the earlier case's copy beside
        // whoever holds that case, and a decision in that place would commit naming a copy erased under it.
        const first = await Promise.race([
          untilBlocked(apiDb, marker).then(() => "waited" as const, () => "never waited" as const),
          redacting.then(() => "ended without waiting" as const, () => "ended without waiting" as const),
        ]);
        expect(first).toBe("waited");
        expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(false);
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await holding;
      }
      expect(await redacting).toEqual({ changed: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.later)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${r.removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    });

    test("a correction of an earlier case's decision that names a copy the R4 redaction is erasing waits for the redaction at that case and is refused before it commits: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`)).toEqual({ changed: true });
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.earlier, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.imageRemoval, actions: [act("restore_media", r.mediaIds[0]!)] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the earlier case, and that already waits for the redaction, which holds
        // that case's row because it erases that case's copy. A redaction that held only its own case would let the
        // correction read the copy whole and commit naming it.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.earlier}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what its tests committed is removed, and the moderation tables and the four auth tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
    profilesMade.length = 0;

    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
```

```ts
      expect(callable).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["append_confirmed_audit", "release_outcomes", "snapshot_withheld", "staff_case_conflict"]));
      for (const name of ["moderation_apply", "item_current_outcome", "account_is_staff", "staff_party_conflict"]) expect(callable, name).not.toContain(name);
    });

    test("the migrator owns the three functions of 0017; the API role may call the two that answer who reviews, and the three it replaced keep their owner and grants", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The appeal's trigger function fires for every role and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_reviewer_state: [true, true],
        appeals_check: [true, false],
        review_needs_admin: [true, true],
        // Replaced by 0017 with CREATE OR REPLACE, which keeps what 0016 gave them.
        decision_actions_apply: [true, false],
        decisions_apply: [true, false],
        decisions_record: [true, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // The replaced functions are the new ones: a review is accepted, an appeal is answered, and a seal is asked of the view.
      const definition = (name: string) => rows.find((f) => f.name === `public.${name}`)!.definition;
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).toMatch(/reviewer_conflict/);
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).not.toMatch(/waits for the migration/);
      expect(definition("decisions_apply")).toMatch(/UPDATE public\.appeals/);
      expect(definition("decision_actions_apply")).toMatch(/measures_in_force m WHERE m\.id = NEW\.id/);
      // review_needs_admin reads the decision and its ledger, never the freeze.
      expect(definition("review_needs_admin")).not.toMatch(/frozen|intake_items|cases/);
    });

    test("frozen_for is named only by post_frozen and by the keep trigger's function; post_frozen only by decisions_record, erase_snapshots, redact_r4_body and order_preservation_end", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const naming = (word: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => word.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // Each function's own definition holds its name.
      expect(naming(/\bfrozen_for\b/)).toEqual(["public.frozen_for", "public.post_frozen", "public.post_media_keep"]);
      // One function of 0016 reads the freeze: the one that stores whether a decision was taken while nobody could open the images.
      // And two of 0018: the one function that erases a snapshot (gate E), and the R4 redaction, which waits while its post is frozen.
      // And (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation, which waits as the redaction does.
      expect(naming(/\bpost_frozen\b/)).toEqual(["public.decisions_record", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.post_frozen", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Nor does a view, a trigger, a constraint, an index or a policy name either.
      const others = (await otherDefinitions()).filter((d) => /\b(frozen_for|post_frozen)\b/.test(d.definition));
      expect(others.map((d) => `${d.kind} ${d.name}`)).toEqual([]);
```
