### Create `packages/db/migrations/0029_orders_retention.sql`

```sql
-- Preservation and retention of authorities' orders (3f design, section 6.4; Task 4, "Preservation, retention and the page
-- status"). Written by hand: this migration changes no table and replaces no function. It adds the four functions the
-- retention job calls (section 7.18): the end of a preservation, the one erasure 3f makes; the orders whose records are
-- due; their erasure; and the deletion of handled contact messages and old outbox rows. The design numbers it 0027; 3e's
-- dry run ended at 0025 and Tasks 1 to 3 took 0026 to 0028, so it is the next free number.
--
-- As in 0016 to 0028: every function is owned by the migrator, pins its search path to public and pg_temp, names every
-- object schema-qualified and has EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC; the four are SECURITY DEFINER with EXECUTE to korbat_api
-- alone, and each checks its own rule again against values the API role cannot set, so an API that asks early, or names
-- the wrong row, changes nothing. Times the database writes are now(), the transaction's start, unless clock_timestamp()
-- is named; errors carry their code as the message under SQLSTATE P0001; a read that must see what committed while a
-- lock waited is a statement of its own after that lock. Every number is read from order_rules(); no interval literal.
--
-- 1. order_preservation_end: the end of a preservation (6.4, 7.11), and the only erasure 3f makes. It answers true when
-- the preservation ended (with or without an erasure) and false when the post is still frozen, which leaves everything
-- as it was for the next round, as redact_r4_body does. In this order:
--   1. The locks, in the order of section 5 (the lock order, item 3): the cases first, in id order in one statement (the
--      case of the item's decision, and every case that holds an unerased snapshot of the post, since step 5 erases
--      those, as redact_r4_body locks the cases of the snapshots it erases: a decision on one of them that had read its
--      snapshot unerased waits for this, and this for it); then the item's row; then the post; then its image rows in id
--      order. The item comes before the post because the effect transaction holds an item's row before it locks any
--      post. An imported item whose measure was never taken again has no decision, so no case of its own.
--   2. In statements of their own: read_committed_only outside READ COMMITTED (the freeze is read below, and gate K and E
--      need a fresh snapshot); not_due unless the item, read again, still has the decision whose case was locked, a
--      preserve_until at or before now() and no preserve_ended_at.
--   3. When the item's measure does not stand: preserve_ended_at = now() and the event preservation_ended. Nothing is
--      erased.
--   4. When post_frozen(post) is still true (an unanswered suspect item, a seal in force, or another order's item that
--      still preserves the post): nothing changes, and it answers false.
--   5. Otherwise, while the measure stands: preserve_ended_at = now(); the post's body blanked and posts.erased_at =
--      now(), the same instant as preserve_ended_at, which is how a reader tells an erasure from an end without one;
--      every image row of the post marked erased; every unerased snapshot of the post, in this case and any other,
--      through erase_snapshots; the case's holds on those images released; moderation_apply, by which an erased post is
--      removed for good; the event preservation_ended, by the system. The image files then go the way every erased
--      image's do: the retention job's disposal deletes the rows, and their files are requested after its commit.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."order_preservation_end"(item_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  v_named public.legal_order_items;
  v_item public.legal_order_items;
  v_case uuid;
  v_stands boolean;
  v_frozen boolean;
  v_images uuid[];
BEGIN
  -- 1. What the locks need, read before them: the item's post never changes, and its decision changes only by a new
  -- disabling, which step 2 notices.
  SELECT x.* INTO v_named FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = order_preservation_end.item_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_named.post_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found';
  END IF;
  SELECT d.case_id INTO v_case FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.id = v_named.decision_id;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cases k
    WHERE k.id = v_case
       OR k.id IN (SELECT s.case_id FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                    WHERE s.target_type = 'post' AND s.target_id = v_named.post_id AND s.erased_at IS NULL)
    ORDER BY k.id FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = v_named.id FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = v_named.post_id FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = v_named.post_id ORDER BY m.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;

  -- 2.
  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'read_committed_only' USING ERRCODE = '25000';
  END IF;
  SELECT x.* INTO v_item FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = v_named.id;
  IF v_item.decision_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_named.decision_id OR v_item.preserve_until IS NULL OR v_item.preserve_until > now()
     OR v_item.preserve_ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_due';
  END IF;

  -- 3.
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = v_item.action_id) INTO v_stands;
  IF NOT v_stands THEN
    UPDATE public.legal_order_items x SET preserve_ended_at = now() WHERE x.id = v_item.id;
    INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, at, by_staff, via)
    VALUES (v_item.order_id, v_item.id, 'preservation_ended', clock_timestamp(), NULL, 'system');
    RETURN true;
  END IF;

  -- 4.
  SELECT public.post_frozen(v_item.post_id) INTO v_frozen;
  IF v_frozen THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- 5.
  UPDATE public.legal_order_items x SET preserve_ended_at = now() WHERE x.id = v_item.id;
  UPDATE public.posts p SET body = '', erased_at = now() WHERE p.id = v_item.post_id;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(m.id ORDER BY m.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO v_images FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = v_item.post_id;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now() WHERE m.post_id = v_item.post_id;
  PERFORM public.erase_snapshots(ARRAY(SELECT s.id FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                                        WHERE s.target_type = 'post' AND s.target_id = v_item.post_id AND s.erased_at IS NULL));
  IF v_case IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public.release_case_holds(v_case, v_images);
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[v_item.post_id], true);
  INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, at, by_staff, via)
  VALUES (v_item.order_id, v_item.id, 'preservation_ended', clock_timestamp(), NULL, 'system');
  RETURN true;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."order_preservation_end"(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."order_preservation_end"(uuid) TO korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 2. order_records_due(): the orders whose records are due (6.4, 6.8, row 42): the newest event of the order is older
-- than record_keep_years; no measure of any of its decisions is in force; no item of it has a preservation that has not
-- ended; and no decision about one of its items' posts is untold (informed_at null): the order's own decisions, their
-- corrections, and korbat's own decisions held with them (6.3), since the notice that tells them reads the order's row.
-- An order nothing acted on is due three years after its opening, like any other.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."order_records_due"() RETURNS TABLE (order_id uuid)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT o.id
    FROM public.legal_orders o
   CROSS JOIN public.order_rules() r
   WHERE (SELECT max(e.at) FROM public.legal_order_events e WHERE e.order_id = o.id) < now() - make_interval(years => r.record_keep_years)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i
                       JOIN public.decisions d ON d.order_item_id = i.id
                       JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.decision_id = d.id
                      WHERE i.order_id = o.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i
                      WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.preserve_until IS NOT NULL AND i.preserve_ended_at IS NULL)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i
                       JOIN public.cases c ON c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = i.post_id
                       JOIN public.decisions d ON d.case_id = c.id
                      WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND d.informed_at IS NULL)
$$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."order_records_due"() FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."order_records_due"() TO korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 3. erase_order_records: the order's row FOR UPDATE, which an effect (decisions_record takes it FOR SHARE), a command and
-- a correction wait for or are waited for; then, in a statement of its own, not_due unless order_records_due() names
-- it. It deletes the order's events, its items (a decision's order_item_id becomes null: the foreign key is on delete
-- set null), the order's row with its texts, and its message when no other order names it, and answers how many rows
-- it deleted. The ledger's rows and the audit log's stay (3c 6.6): a decision of the kind order then says only that an
-- order was given effect, and when. Outbox rows that name the order have no key to it and go by delete_contact_messages.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."erase_order_records"(order_id uuid) RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  v_message uuid;
  v_rows integer;
  v_deleted integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT o.message_id INTO v_message FROM public.legal_orders o WHERE o.id = erase_order_records.order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_records_due() d WHERE d.order_id = erase_order_records.order_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_due';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.legal_order_events e WHERE e.order_id = erase_order_records.order_id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_deleted := v_deleted + v_rows;
  DELETE FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.order_id = erase_order_records.order_id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_deleted := v_deleted + v_rows;
  DELETE FROM public.legal_orders o WHERE o.id = erase_order_records.order_id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_deleted := v_deleted + v_rows;
  IF v_message IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.contact_messages m
     WHERE m.id = v_message AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_orders o WHERE o.message_id = m.id);
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
    v_deleted := v_deleted + v_rows;
  END IF;
  RETURN v_deleted;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."erase_order_records"(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."erase_order_records"(uuid) TO korbat_api;--> statement-breakpoint
-- 4. delete_contact_messages: not_due unless older_than is at least message_keep_days back; then it deletes the messages
-- handled before older_than that no order names (an order's message goes with the order), and the outbox rows created
-- before older_than, except those whose subject is still open: a message without a disposition, or an order that is not
-- closed and has an item neither disabled nor closed. alert_steps() writes an escalation or a reminder only while no
-- row of it is newer than the step's threshold, so deleting those would let it meet an old threshold again and write a
-- new order_due at priority 5 every 30 days. An unhandled message is never deleted, a stale one included: the row is the
-- record that a message arrived and nobody looked at it. It answers how many rows it deleted.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."delete_contact_messages"(older_than timestamptz) RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  v_rows integer;
  v_deleted integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF delete_contact_messages.older_than IS NULL
     OR delete_contact_messages.older_than > now() - make_interval(days => (SELECT r.message_keep_days FROM public.order_rules() r)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_due';
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.contact_messages m
   WHERE m.disposition IS NOT NULL AND m.handled_at < delete_contact_messages.older_than
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_orders o WHERE o.message_id = m.id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_deleted := v_deleted + v_rows;

  DELETE FROM public.alert_outbox a
   WHERE a.created_at < delete_contact_messages.older_than
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.contact_messages m WHERE m.id = a.message_id AND m.disposition IS NULL)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_orders o
                      WHERE o.id = a.order_id AND o.closed_at IS NULL
                        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i
                                     WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.disabled_at IS NULL AND i.closed_at IS NULL));
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_deleted + v_rows;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."delete_contact_messages"(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."delete_contact_messages"(timestamptz) TO korbat_api;
```

          ],

        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding'"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

      `Replies waiting: ${n}, the oldest for ${age}. A held suspension does not start until its reply is answered, and a terminated account is not deleted before its reply is.`,
    strikes: (n: number) => `Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: ${n}.`,
  },
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 5 (design, sections 8.3, 8.4 and 8.7)
  /** 8.3: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it. Both cite R6; the composer sets it. */
  reporting: {
    warnLabel: "Warn about reporting",
    restrictLabel: "Restrict reporting",
    /** Beside both controls. */
    rule: "Both measures cite R6; the composer sets it.",
    /** [warn.what], with the account's counts as this page read them. */
    warnWhat: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `A warning restricts nothing. It tells the account that ${unfounded} of the ${reports} reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded, lists them, and says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction. A report counts once, however many of its items were marked, and by the day it was sent. A notice of illegal content is never counted.`,
    /** [warn.short] */
    warnShort: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `Not open: a warning needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks} marked reports among those the account sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days, and they must be at least half of its rule reports sent in that time. This account has ${unfounded} of ${reports}. One report never reaches the number alone.`,
    /** [warn.standing] */
    warnStanding: (warnedOn: string) => `Not open: the warning of ${warnedOn} still counts.`,
    /** [restrict.what], with the days chosen. */
    restrictWhat: (days: number) =>
      `This stops the account's reports under korbat's rules for ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination stay open to it.`,
    /** [restrict.noWarning] */
    restrictNoWarning: "Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.",
    /** [restrict.short] */
    restrictShort: (marksSince: number, warnedOn: string) => `Not open: ${marksSince} of the reports the account sent since the warning of ${warnedOn} were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`,
    /** [restrict.running] */
    restrictRunning: (restrictedUntil: string) => `Not open: a restriction runs until ${restrictedUntil}.`,
    /** How many days, at most the restriction's own number. */
    daysLabel: `Days (1 to ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays})`,
    /** 8.7: the reversal of each reporting measure, named by what it lifts. */
    liftWarning: "Lift the warning about reporting",
    liftRestriction: "Lift the restriction of reporting",
  },
  /** 8.4: the mark "manifestly unfounded" beside the items a "No breach" decision answers, and its withdrawal. */
  mark: {
    /** [mark.label] */
    label: "Manifestly unfounded",
    /** [mark.rule] */
    rule: `Tick only a report that anyone could see was unfounded without weighing it: it names nothing the rule could cover. A report you had to think about is not manifestly unfounded, also when you found no breach. Your key signs the mark. What counts toward a warning about reporting is the report, once, for ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days from the day it was sent, however many of its items are ticked. The person who sent it sees the mark on their own list of reports once this answer is released to them, and can ask for a re-examination.`,
    /** [mark.never], once, when an item the decision answers cannot be marked. */
    never: "Only a signed-in person's report under a rule can be marked: never a notice of illegal content, a report on the path for child sexual abuse material, or a report sent without an account.",
    /** [mark.undone] */
    undone: "A mark stops counting when a re-examination of its report ends in a restriction, and when a correction of the decision that set it withdraws it.",
    /** [mark.withdraw]: the control, and what it does. */
    withdrawLabel: "Withdraw this decision's marks",
    withdrawWhat:
      "Use this when the reports were arguable after all: it was wrong to call them manifestly unfounded, also if no rule was broken. All marks this decision set are withdrawn together. The outcome of each report stays. The marks stop counting when you confirm, so a warning lifted because its marks were wrong cannot be given again on them.",
    /** On the case page, beside an item whose mark stands and one whose mark was withdrawn (CaseItem.markWithdrawn). */
    marked: "Marked manifestly unfounded",
    withdrawn: "Mark withdrawn",
    /** In place of the preview: the withdrawal sends the author nothing. */
    noStatement: "No statement is sent: withdrawing marks changes nothing for the author of what was reported, and the people who reported see it on their own lists.",
    /** The fieldset's legend. */
    legend: "Reports this decision answers",
  },
  /** 8.7: [review.warning], when a restriction of reporting rests on the reviewed decision's warning. */
  reviewWarning: "A restriction of this account's reports rests on this warning. If you lift the warning, the restriction ends when you confirm, and this decision's statement says so.",
  /** 8.5: [appeals.order] */
  appealsOrder: "Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.",
  /** 8.5: the mark of an appeal listed first. */
  appealsFirst: "a running suspension or a termination",
} as const;

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile; and the refusals of
  // Task 2's order routes.
  "message_handled",
  "order_needs_message",
  "order_exists",
  "order_closed",
  "order_event_refused",
  "already_released",
  // 3f Task 3 (design, sections 8.5 and 8.9): the refusals of giving effect to an order.
  "order_changed",
  "order_not_verified",
  "order_cap",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** 3f [open.duplicate]: an order of this state, authority and reference is recorded already (order_exists). */
const OPEN_DUPLICATE =
  "An order of this authority with this reference is already recorded. If that record is wrong, correct it on its screen; if it is closed, an admin reopens it there. Do not open the order a second time under a changed reference.";

/** The console's words for each of them. A recusal reads the same whether the conflict concerns the author or a reporter. */
export const MODERATION_MESSAGES: Record<ConsoleModerationCode, string> = {

  admin_required: "Only an admin can take this decision.",

  order_cap: `You have given effect to ${ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay} order items in 24 hours, the most one staff account may. Another staff member goes on; tell the operator at once.`,

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.

/**

 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

import {

  COMPOSER,
  complete,

  answerable,
